title: Winning Post 3
overview:
Building your very own bloodline is seriously fun! Put Okabe or Take in the saddle for a real life of luxury as a racehorse owner!

The stage is the horse racing world of the near future. With 3 billion yen in funds as your capital, hire a secretary, acquire a stallion, and a "life as an owner" with no time limit awaits you.

1. Building bloodlines is seriously fun!
"Bloodline building" is super realistic! The romance of passing down your own bloodline is moving. That makes the foals even cuter, and you get even more fired up about the races!

2. Real-name jockeys make it seriously fun!
Top-class jockeys such as Okabe, Take and Matoba appear under their real names with lifelike CG! They can ride your horses, and they'll even make excuses when they lose. Much-talked-about thoroughbreds also appear under their real names!

3. Seriously fun worldwide!
Take on the world's greatest races that move fans to tears, such as the "Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe" and the "Kentucky Derby"! Regional exchange races such as the "Teio Sho" and the "Tokyo Daishoten" are also greatly increased!

4. A varied owner's life is seriously fun!
Relationships with a total of 230 people, including secretaries, advisors, trainers and jockeys! They give you advice and look after you, for an even more varied life as an owner. All kinds of events are hugely expanded too!

自分だけの血統づくりが、スゴ面白い！
岡部や武を乗せて、リアル極楽馬主人生！

舞台は近未来の競馬界。30億円の資金を元手に、秘書を雇い、種牡馬を譲り受けて、時間制限なしの“馬主人生”があなたを待っています。

1 血統づくりがスゴ面白い！
「血統づくり」が超リアル！自分の血統を伝えていくロマンが感動的。だから、より仔馬が可愛いし、レースにも熱くなっちゃう！

2 実名の騎手でスゴ面白い！
岡部、武、的場など超一流騎手が実名＆そっくりCGで登場！自分の馬に乗せられるし、負けたら言い訳までしてくれるのだ。話題のサラブレッドまで実名で登場！

3 ワールドワイドにスゴ面白い！
「凱旋門賞」「ケンタッキーダービー」など、ファン感涙の世界最高のレースに挑戦できる！さらに「帝王賞」「東京大賞典」のような地方交流レースも大幅に増加！

4 多彩な馬主人生がスゴ面白い！
秘書、顧問、調教師、騎手など総勢230名の人間関係！アドバイスされたり面倒みたりと、さらに多彩な馬主人生。各種イベントもグ―――ンと大充実！
